themes.title: Hospitality & travel up-cycle
themes.need: Q1FY27 split hotels from airlines. INDHOTEL delivered a 17th consecutive record quarter - consolidated revenue INR 2,419cr (+15%), EBITDA INR 753cr at 31.1%, standalone occupancy jumping to 82% from 76% on a 41.8% standalone EBITDA margin, and asset-light management-fee income INR 168cr (+26%) - with management now framing the West-Asia war as a NET tailwind because outbound travel stays home; leisure RevPAR (Rajasthan/Goa) ran up high-20s. Airlines got the mirror image: INDIGO's EBITDAR margin collapsed from 28.0% to 15.6% on blended ATF of ~INR 140-150/litre versus INR 85-90 pre-war (fuel CASK +~80% YoY), leaving yield as the only defence. MHRIL shows domestic leisure premiumisation is real - Keystone average unit realisation +73% to INR 14.4 lakh on stable gross sales. LEMONTREE/CHALET/SAMHI/THELEELA ride the same occupancy-led room cycle; TRAVELFOOD/TBOTEK/DREAMFOLKS remain levered to airport PAX and B2B travel.
themes.driver: Occupancy-led (not rate-led) RevPAR compounding plus INDHOTEL's Ginger conversion cadence stepping 15->20->25->40 per quarter through FY27; for airlines the swing is INDIGO's guided Q2 PRASK growth of 'more than 25%' on flattish capacity against ATF cracks.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Snapshot claims "7+ Decades of Presence in India", 24 properties, 1,950+ keys across 9 States/U.T. and 5 brands; incorporated on March 21, 1986 by Dr. Vithal Venketesh Kamat and now led by 3rd-generation hotelier Mr. Vishal Vithal Kamat.
- The 'Orchid' brand is described as "Asia's 1st chain of 5-star Environment Sensitive Hotel which has won over 95 National & International awards" and branded elsewhere as "Asia's First Ecotel Chain".
- Multi-tier brand architecture spanning premium (The Orchid, Fort JadhavGadh, Mahodadhi Palace, Toyam) and mid-premium (Lotus Resorts, IRA by Orchid) — the deck frames this as covering "luxury to value for money categories across India".
- Claimed customer moat: "Brand Loyalty (61% of our sales come from repeat customers.)", supported by a stated "Integrated Feedback Loop" and feedback-driven customer-centricity.
- Two newer brands are dated in the portfolio table as "Launched in July 2023" and "Launched in July 2024", alongside tenures of 27+, 16+ and 12+ years — the table's brand header row is lost in extraction, so which brand carries which age is not asserted here.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Portfolio exit] IRA Mumbai closed effective April 1, 2026; the deck's same-store note excludes both this closure and four hotels added during Q1FY27 (Orchid Panchagani and Rishikesh, IRA by Orchid in Hyderabad and Bhavnagar), on which basis revenue grew 17% and EBITDA grew 21% versus reported growth of 10% and 36%.
- [Internal contradiction — Rishikesh] The same-store note lists Orchid Rishikesh among four hotels ADDED during Q1FY27, while the Upcoming Properties table lists Rishikesh (Orchid, Revenue Sharing, 44 rooms) with an opening date of March 2027; both readings appear in the same deck.
- [Internal contradiction — Dwarka brand] Business highlights and the pipeline table call the 63-key Dwarka property an "Orchid" hotel, while the Presence Across India map lists it as "IRA by Orchid, Dwarka".
- [Senior hires] CFO Mr. Milind Wadekar joined from Ventive Hospitality (EVP Finance & IR) and was earlier CFO at Chalet Hotels; VP Sales Mr. Sanjeev Advani was Director of Sales at Lemon Tree Hotels — the deck showcases a recently professionalised senior team alongside promoter family management.
- [IR outsourced] The presentation was prepared by Valorem Advisors, an independent investor-relations firm, which carries its own disclaimer.
